description: Create a link to the secure top-up page, for the user to open and pay by card themselves. Creating the link charges nothing. Refuses a meter EVS doesn't recognise. If EVS can't be reached, meterVerified is false, so ask the user to check the meter on the page. NUS allows $6-$50 and SUTD allows $10-$50.
